{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u068/system/state/workspace/programs/task-29ebe1f3.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # The two color-4 markers indicate that the color-8 motif is repeated twice
    # in a horizontal strip.
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 8]
    if not cells:
        return []
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in cells)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in cells)
    motif = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]
    return [row + row for row in motif]
"
}
